{{Quote|Welcome to the Palace of the Jedi! Brave you must be, a great challenge have you.|Yoda, greeting the recruit|<ref name="YCAC" />}}
Around [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], in the aftermath of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], a '''young new recruit''' was brought to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and placed under the responsibility of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]. The old [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] assigned various tasks to the [[Youngling/Legends|young]] recruit related to helping the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] return to a state of peace after the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] invasion of the world, and to also keeping [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], a rising star of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], content in his new role as a Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]].

Despite being very young and still [[Jedi training/Legends|untrained]], the child proved very resourceful in completing difficult tasks such as terminating the remaining [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] lurking in the [[Sacred Forest of Naboo]], finding ancient [[Unidentified Gungan sacred statues|statues]] in the [[Gungan Caves]], and fixing the personal [[Computer/Legends|computer]] of [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]], ruler of Naboo. Under the watchful gaze of Yoda himself, the young recruit also recorded a collection of songs for Skywalker and [[Programmer/Legends|programmed]] stories into the [[Memory bank/Legends|memory core]] of [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], Skywalker's homemade [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]].

==History==
===Early life===
{{Quote|Six missions there are.|Yoda|<ref name="YCAC" />}}
[[File:Yoda_awaits.png|thumb|right|250px|Yoda waiting for his new recruit in the High Council Chamber]]
Around [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] recruited a [[Youngling/Legends|young]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] on behalf of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and sent the individual to be [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The child boarded a [[Consular-class light cruiser/Legends|''Consular''-class space cruiser]] bound for the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] and, upon arrival, was directed to [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] of the Order. Yoda had recently returned from the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]<ref name="YCAC" /> after the [[Funeral of Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|funeral]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], Kenobi's Master. The recent events of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Naboo crisis]], in which the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] invaded Naboo with an [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|army]] of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], had left many scars.<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>

Despite victory over the Trade Federation's [[Trooper/Legends|troops]] and the possible discovery of the [[Chosen One/Legends|Chosen One]]&mdash;a being prophesied to restore balance to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]&mdash;in the person of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]],<ref name="TPM" /> much remained to be done. Yoda thus commissioned the child to undertake six missions directly linked to the late crisis.<ref name="YCAC" /> It was rather unusual for a mere [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiate]] to be allowed to venture off-world,<ref name="TJP">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref> but the Grand Master placed exceptional trust in the recruit as he bestowed his blessing to leave the Temple.<ref name="YCAC" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}

===Restoring peace on Naboo===
{{Quote|A great victory the Republic won on Naboo. A celebration there is. Queen Amidala challenged Jar Jar Binks with a race between friends.|Yoda|<ref name="YCAC" />}}
[[File:Droid_trap.png|thumb|left|260px|A droid about to fall into a trap]]
Yoda first tasked the young [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] recruit with helping at the [[Victory Races of Naboo]], which were organized to celebrate the friendly relations between the two peoples of the planet, the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] and the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]].<ref name="YCAC" /> [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] of the Naboo and [[Bombad General/Legends|Bombad General]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] of the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]],<ref name="TPM" /> both key actors in the recent reconciliation between the two peoples, were to participate in the races, each on a different [[Species/Legends|species]] of mount&mdash;Binks on a [[Kaadu/Legends|kaadu]], and Amidala on a [[tusk cat]]. Yoda tasked the young Jedi recruit with advising them on choosing from the available paths through the terrains that the race circuit covered, since each steed preferred different types of terrain. The youngling favored one of the competitors.<ref name="YCAC" />

Despite the fact that the Federation's single [[Vuutun Palaa/Legends|Droid Control Ship]] had been [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|destroyed]], deactivating most of the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] and [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]] stationed on Naboo, active battle [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were discovered pillaging the [[Sacred Forest of Naboo]]. The Jedi recruit helped Binks activate droid traps hidden throughout the [[Tree/Legends|woods]], triggered by a [[Drum/Legends|drum]]-like mechanism. Different types of traps were involved, including hidden pits and [[Booma/Legends|booma]]-launching devices. To make them work properly, the recruit needed to reproduce a specific beat.<ref name="YCAC" />

[[File:Jewel_doors.png|thumb|right|260px|The doors leading to the golden statues]]
Due to a mistake by Binks, Amidala's personal [[Computer/Legends|computer]] on her [[J-type 327 Nubian royal starship/Legends|royal starship]] had malfunctioned, and the fluke resulted in the loss of files of great importance to the [[Queen/Legends|queen]]. After resolving tangram puzzles, the recruit fixed the computer and restored valuable pictures related to the conflict on Naboo, in the process acquiring knowledge about the recent invasion. Among other subjects, the files included data and images of the [[Seraph-class urban landspeeder|''Seraph''-class urban landspeeder]] and the [[Anakin Skywalker's Podracer/Legends|podracer]] that Anakin Skywalker had used to win the [[Boonta Eve Classic (32 BBY)/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] [[Podracing/Legends|podrace]].<ref name="YCAC" />

At the request of the Gungans, the young recruit went to find four [[Unidentified Gungan sacred statues|sacred statues]] inside the ancient [[Gungan Caves]]. Each relic was hidden behind a sealed door, and the youngling had to find ten jewels per door that, together, acted as keys to open the stone slab. The recruit explored a maze of tunnels filled with doors decorated with red [[Spider/Legends|spiders]], [[Color/Legends|colorful]] lizards, and mysterious carvings. The youth successfully discovered the jewels hidden in the cave system, relying on visual cues such as [[Plant/Legends|plants]] and rocks. Once the doors were opened, they finally revealed their treasures.<ref name="YCAC" />

===Missions on Tatooine===
{{Quote|C-3PO, Anakin's droid. To him, knowledge of the Jedi you must bring.|Yoda|<ref name="YCAC" />}}
[[File:Bith_band_Mos_Espa.png|thumb|left|250px|The Bith band and Tili Tili]]
Yoda tasked the Jedi recruit with traveling to the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], where the [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] had been left unfinished by his creator, Anakin Skywalker. Yoda asked the young recruit to [[Programmer/Legends|program]] stories into the droid's [[Memory bank/Legends|memory]], and the young Jedi input tales and anecdotes related to Skywalker, Amidala, and the Jedi into C-3PO. These tales notably included a conversation between Skywalker and Amidala in which the boy confessed he missed [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|his mother]].<ref name="YCAC" /> Despite the new programming, the droid later claimed that he was never good at storytelling.<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>

Skywalker had been forced to leave Tatooine and his [[Parent/Legends|mother]] in order to join the Jedi Order,<ref name="TPM" /> and Yoda suggested to the recruit that they help put together a songbook to remind Skywalker of his [[Homeworld/Legends|home planet]]. The new recruit ventured to [[Akim's Munch/Legends|Akim's Munch]], a street cafe located in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]]. There, the youngling worked with a [[Unidentified Bith band|Bith band]], the [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] [[Musician/Legends|singer]] [[Tili Tili]], and a [[Tiperoo]] to record thirty-one songs on a [[Music/Legends|musical]] keyboard. These songs were Skywalker's favorites, and most of them directly referenced events from his life or from the Battle of Naboo. The musical pieces included "[[Growing up on Tatooine]]," "[[Ja Ja Jabba]]," "[[I Want to Go to Naboo]]," "[[Everybody's Got Something to Sell]]," and "[[Watto Steals You Blind]]."<ref name="YCAC" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|With you, I will always be.|Master Yoda|<ref name="YCAC" />}}
While Jedi Initiates were usually attached to a [[Clan (Jedi)/Legends|clan]] under the training of an [[Jedi instructor|instructor]] and rarely left the Jedi Temple,<ref name="TJP" /> Grand Master Yoda showed trust in the youngling and tasked the new recruit with missions that required travel off-world from Coruscant to remote planets such as Naboo and Tatooine. The young recruit showed bravery in navigating the underground passages on Naboo, and aptitude for music, problem solving, programming, and tangram puzzles. Yoda thought highly of the young recruit's courage and logical thinking, and he took great personal interest in following the completion of the child's tasks.<ref name="YCAC" />

==Behind the scenes==
In [[1998]], [[Lucas Learning]] released the educational [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Yoda's Challenge Activity Center]]'', in which the player assumes the role of a promising Jedi recruit. The game never specifies the recruit's name, species, or sex, simply describing the character as a "young new recruit," and allowing the player to give the character a name of his or her choosing. The game is targeted at children aged six to eight and includes six different puzzles. These puzzles can be played in any order; this article arranges them in the order they are presented on the in-game menu.<ref name="YCAC" />
